integrity: The result is proved analytically for every m>=3 and every real q>0; finite exact-rational tests supplement but do not prove the universal quantifiers. No third-party paper or externally issued certification is included.
scientific_limitations: Only centered graph-ball maximal averaging on finite stars with a common positive leaf mass, variable positive hub mass, and unweighted edge 1-variation. Earlier counting-measure case is known. Prior weighted-star treatments may remain unlocated; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Exact hub-mass minimax law for centered maximal variation on equimass-leaf stars
